title: So many fun surprises and casting choices I never would’ve thought of...
transcript: Roundabout just announced the most insane cast for The Rocky Horror Show Broadway revival, and we have to talk about it because there are some absolutely wild choices. The headline for me is Stephanie Shiu coming back to Broadway, now with an Oscar nomination under her belt, playing the role of Janet. Her Brad is going to be Andrew Durand, one of my favorite actors. Speaking of favourite actors, Amber Gray as Riff Raff is insane. This role, obviously normally played by a man, Amber Gray is one of those actors you could literally put in any role and I am instantly sold. Magenta is going to be Juliet Lewis, and I'll be honest, I'm not really familiar with her work, but this seems to be a pretty big get. She is an Oscar nominee and has done a ton of film and TV, and so chances are you have probably seen her in something. Michaela J. Rodriguez is going to be playing Columbia. I have been dying for her to come to Broadway for a while. This is her Broadway debut, and while honestly I may rather see her, Janet or magenta, just having her as a part of this cast is incredibly exciting. Perhaps the most unexpected casting choice, and that's saying something, is Rachel Dratch as the narrator. She is one of the funniest performers alive. And yeah, I don't think I ever would have thought of this casting myself, but a brilliant 10 out of 10. No notes. And finally we have Harvey Gien as Eddie and Doctor Scott. This one is very interesting to me cause I've really only seen Harvey play quiet and meek characters. Eddie is like anything but. So I think this is going to be a very different side of him, which I'm really excited for. And he is also incredibly funny, so I am excited for his doctor Scott as well.
reasoning: The video is entirely about reacting to a newly announced cast for the upcoming Rocky Horror Show Broadway revival. The creator has not seen the production — it hasn't opened yet.
